semantics.mapped_jobs: Unique Buildkite command-job UUIDs whose explicit queue rule maps to a monitored AMD queue; retry attempts are included as distinct UUIDs.
semantics.daily_bucket: UTC date when the job mapping record was created.
semantics.started_jobs: Mapped jobs with a Buildkite started_at timestamp.
semantics.mapped_gpu_slots: Sum of configured GPUs per mapped job; not GPU-hours.
semantics.gpu_hours: Sum of started-to-finished wall hours multiplied by configured GPUs per job; unfinished and stale >24h records are excluded.
semantics.privacy: Only daily aggregates are published; raw jobs and UUIDs are not retained.
